passages.original: Quae de Catilina Sallustius scribit hoc gesta sunt tempore.
passages.english: The things that Sallust writes about Catiline were done at this time.

passages.original: Scribit idem Josephus, quod eodem anno Pilatns praeses secreto noctis imagines Cæsaris in templo statuerit.
passages.english: The same Josephus writes that in the same year the governor Pilate, secretly by night, set up images of Caesar in the temple.

passages.original: Titus, Judæa capta et Jerosolymis subversis, sexcentena millia virorum interlicit. Josephus scribit, undecies centena ,lilia fame et gladio periisse, et alia centum millia captivorum publice venumdata. Ut autem tanta multitudo Jerosolymis reperiretur, causam Azymorum festum fuisse : ob quod ex omni 706 gente Judæi ad templum confluentes, urbe quasi carcere sunt reclusi.
passages.english: Titus, having captured Judaea and overthrown Jerusalem, killed six hundred thousand men. Josephus writes that eleven hundred thousand perished by famine and sword, and another hundred thousand captives were publicly sold. And [he writes] that the reason so great a multitude was found in Jerusalem was the feast of Unleavened Bread: on account of which the Jews, flocking together to the temple from every nation, were shut up in the city as if in a prison.
passages.notes: 'interlicit' read as 'interficit' and ',lilia' as 'millia' (scanning errors). The number 706 in the text is a page or column mark and has been omitted.

passages.original: Romæ XXIX episcopus constituitur EUSEBIUS : post cujus septimum mensem XXX Ecelesiam tenet MELCHIADES b annis tribus.
passages.english: At Rome EUSEBIUS is appointed the twenty-ninth bishop; after whose seventh month MELCHIADES, the thirtieth, holds the Church for three years.
passages.notes: 'Ecelesiam' read as 'Ecclesiam'; the stray 'b' is a footnote mark and has been omitted.

passages.original: d Pro catholica fide multa sublimiter Ambrosius scribit.
passages.english: Ambrose writes much, and loftily, on behalf of the catholic faith.
passages.notes: The initial 'd' is a footnote mark and has been omitted.
